Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryFccCokeRegeneratorBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryFccCokeRegeneratorBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryFccCokeRegeneratorBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable screening-level FCC coke-regenerator carbon and dry-flue-gas balance.

The calculation applies caller-owned coke carbon, burn, carbon-dioxide selectivity, dry-air oxygen, and excess-oxygen assumptions to a qualified FCC yield receipt. It is a stoichiometric allocation, not a regenerator heat balance, catalyst model, emissions compliance calculation, or flue-gas property model.

Version:
1.0
Author:
esolbr1

  • Method Details

    • calculate

      public static RefineryFccCokeRegeneratorBalance calculate(RefineryFccYieldBalance fccYieldBalance, double cokeCarbonMassFraction, double cokeBurnFraction, double burnedCarbonToCarbonDioxideFraction, double dryAirOxygenMoleFraction, double excessOxygenFraction)
      Calculate an FCC coke-regenerator carbon, air, and dry-flue-gas balance.
      Parameters:
      fccYieldBalance - qualified FCC yield receipt
      cokeCarbonMassFraction - carbon mass fraction of the represented coke, in [0, 1]
      cokeBurnFraction - fraction of coke carbon burned, in [0, 1]
      burnedCarbonToCarbonDioxideFraction - fraction of burned carbon forming CO2, in [0, 1]
      dryAirOxygenMoleFraction - oxygen mole fraction in dry air, in (0, 1)
      excessOxygenFraction - supplied oxygen above stoichiometric demand as a fraction of demand
      Returns:
      immutable FCC coke-regenerator receipt
